shared_policy.runtime_profile: Select and record the actual runtime per execution; not provisioned by this catalog.
shared_policy.actual_identity_policy: Logical roles are not GitHub users; preserve the authenticated principal separately.
shared_policy.network_policy: Only explicitly authorized tool/service use; no arbitrary egress or production access.
shared_policy.escalation: Stop and report to the human owner on policy, scope, permission or evidence conflict.
shared_policy.telemetry_policy: Record safe execution IDs, paths, versions and actual results; no secrets or hidden reasoning.
